u0: Quiet state: no unresolved siren is active. The siren is either silent or has already been switched off, so there is nothing to silence now. Continue normal shop activity while watching for the siren to start; when it rings, the task moves to the ringing state.
u1: Ringing state: the siren is active and needs to be turned off. Navigate to the blue siren switch on the bottom wall, face it, and toggle it. A successful switch toggle gives reward and returns the task to the quiet state.
